key_points: HUD announced a fair lending probe into Wells Fargo on Oct 7, raising regulatory and reputational risk.
TD Cowen reinitiated coverage with a Buy rating and Morgan Stanley upgraded to Overweight/Buy ahead of Q3 earnings.
Analysts note the stock trades at a discount after a 117% run, describing it as a potential bargain.
Upcoming Q3 earnings could move the stock ~4% according to options market expectations.
Insider activity shows directors receiving deferred stock units and awards, indicating some confidence.
